description: This file defines a Java class 'TestTask' which extends 'AbstractTask' and represents a scheduled task within the OpenMRS system. The class includes methods for initialization, execution (with occasional exception throwing), and shutdown, as well as a static counter for tracking executions.

classes.name: TestTask
classes.description: A scheduled task implementation that logs activity and throws exceptions periodically to test scheduler behavior.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the task with the provided TaskDefinition, logs the initialization.

methods.name: setExecutionCount
methods.description: Sets the static execution count to a specified value.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the task's main function, logs execution, updates count, and throws exception every ten executions.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Logs shutdown activity and calls superclass shutdown.
